# pbs_api_tokens (Data Source)

Lists the API tokens of one Proxmox Backup Server user, or of every user. Only the tokens' metadata: PBS shows a token's secret only when it creates the token or regenerates its secret. Reading the tokens of other users than the one the provider signs in as needs Sys.Audit on /access/users.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The API tokens the Proxmox VE clusters back up with.
data "pbs_api_tokens" "pve" {
  userid = "pve@pbs"
}

output "pve_token_ids" {
  value = [for t in data.pbs_api_tokens.pve.tokens : t.tokenid]
}

# A disabled token makes the backups of the cluster that uses it fail.
check "pve_tokens_are_enabled" {
  assert {
    condition     = alltrue([for t in data.pbs_api_tokens.pve.tokens : t.enable])
    error_message = "Disabled API tokens of pve@pbs: ${join(", ", [for t in data.pbs_api_tokens.pve.tokens : t.token_name if !t.enable])}."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `userid` (String) List only the tokens of this user, such as `alice@pbs`.

### Read-Only

- `tokens` (Attributes List) The tokens, sorted by token ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tokens))

<a id="nestedatt--tokens"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tokens`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) Comment; null when there is none.
- `enable` (Boolean) Whether the token may sign in.
- `expire` (Number) When the token expires, in seconds since the Unix epoch; `0` for never.
- `token_name` (String) Name of the token, the part of the token ID after `!`.
- `tokenid` (String) Token ID, such as `alice@pbs!ci`.
- `userid` (String) User ID of the user the token belongs to.
